scenarios.title: A｜开玩笑提醒
scenarios.setting: 玩家和朋友约好六点见面。6:20，朋友终于出现。

turns.prompt: 你想用轻松的方式提醒对方迟到了，会怎么说？

choices.text: Only twenty minutes late? You’re improving!

feedback.naturalExpression: Only twenty minutes late? You’re improving!
feedback.explanation: 以“有进步”反讽迟到时间缩短，幽默依赖熟人关系和轻松语气。

choices.text: Wow, look who finally showed up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Wow, look who finally showed up.
feedback.explanation: “look who finally showed up”调侃对方终于出现，陌生或紧张关系中容易听成责备。

choices.text: I was starting to think you meant six tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was starting to think you meant six tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: 用夸张的“明天六点”调侃迟到，语气依赖双方熟悉程度，不是正式追责。

choices.text: Should I just start telling you everything begins thirty minutes earlier?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I just start telling you everything begins thirty minutes earlier?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: You’re late as always.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Only twenty minutes late? You’re improving!
feedback.explanation: “as always”突出对方一贯迟到，容易像责备；若本意是玩笑，需要双方关系和语气支持。

turns.text: Okay, okay 😂 I know I’m terrible.

turns.prompt: 你想接着用玩笑缓和气氛，会怎么说？

choices.text: At least you’re consistent.

feedback.naturalExpression: At least you’re consistent.
feedback.explanation: “at least”表示最低数量或程度，能说明可接受的下限。

choices.text: One day you’re going to surprise me and arrive early.

feedback.naturalExpression: One day you’re going to surprise me and arrive early.
feedback.explanation: 以“早到会让我惊讶”的玩笑回应迟到，适合能接受调侃的朋友关系。

choices.text: I’ll believe it when I see it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll believe it when I see it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Come on, let’s go. I’m starving.

feedback.naturalExpression: Come on, let’s go. I’m starving.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: B｜认真提出问题
scenarios.setting: 朋友又迟到了四十分钟，这次玩家决定认真说。

turns.prompt: 你想认真告诉朋友，反复迟到已经影响了你，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I be honest? The lateness is starting to bother me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I be honest? The lateness is starting to bother me.
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: I know you don’t mean anything by it, but you’re late almost every time we meet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you don’t mean anything by it, but you’re late almost every time we meet.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I need you to take our meeting times a little more seriously.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need you to take our meeting times a little more seriously.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: When I’m waiting forty minutes every time, it makes me feel like my time isn’t being respected.

feedback.naturalExpression: When I’m waiting forty minutes every time, it makes me feel like my time isn’t being respected.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

turns.text: I know I’m bad with time, but I’m not doing it on purpose.

turns.prompt: 你想解释迟到给你造成的影响，会怎么说？

choices.text: I know you’re not doing it intentionally, but it still affects me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you’re not doing it intentionally, but it still affects me.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I understand, but this keeps happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but this keeps happening.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I’m not saying you’re trying to be rude. I’m asking you to make more of an effort.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying you’re trying to be rude. I’m asking you to make more of an effort.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Even a message saying you’re running late would help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Even a message saying you’re running late would help.
feedback.explanation: “running late”表示会比原定时间晚到；补充预计迟到多久，更方便对方调整安排。

turns.text: That’s fair. I’ll try to be better about it.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I don’t expect you to be perfect. I just don’t want to keep waiting without knowing what’s happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I don’t expect you to be perfect. I just don’t want to keep waiting without knowing what’s happening.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: That’s all I’m asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s all I’m asking.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

scenarios.title: C｜改变以后见面的方式
scenarios.setting: 在“朋友总是迟到”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“改变以后见面的方式”。

turns.text: I’m sorry. I know I’m always making you wait.

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友总是迟到」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Maybe we should stop meeting at places where I have to wait outside.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should stop meeting at places where I have to wait outside.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: How about you text me when you’re actually leaving, and I’ll head out then?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about you text me when you’re actually leaving, and I’ll head out then?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Maybe next time we can meet somewhere I can do something while I wait.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe next time we can meet somewhere I can do something while I wait.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: From now on, just let me know when you’re on your way.

feedback.naturalExpression: From now on, just let me know when you’re on your way.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

turns.text: Honestly, texting you when I leave might work better.

turns.prompt: 你想回应调整见面方式的建议，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, then neither of us has to stress about the exact time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, then neither of us has to stress about the exact time.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Let’s try that next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s try that next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: Perfect. Just send me a message when you’re heading out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Just send me a message when you’re heading out.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

turns.prompt: 你想确认双方已就见面方式达成一致，会怎么说？

choices.text: Problem solved.

feedback.naturalExpression: Problem solved.
feedback.explanation: “Problem solved”简短表示问题解决了，适合结束刚才的小插曲。

choices.text: Great. Hopefully no more forty-minute waits 😂

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Hopefully no more forty-minute waits 😂
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。
